_evidence: MEASURED (config.json's layer_types + a single safetensors header, ALL 40 layers checked individually for MoE-expert presence -- not extrapolated from a sample). Zero mlx/torch load, zero HCLI resident contention.
_label: Odyssey I DISCOVERY. First hypothesis (conv=dense-FFN, attention=MoE-FFN, from checking only layers 0 and 2) was WRONG -- caught by checking every layer before publishing.

architecture_TRIPLE_HYBRID.family: conv + sparse-attention + MoE, layered together -- no other specimen surveyed this session combines all three axes. LiquidAI's 'conv' layer type is a SHORT causal depthwise convolution (conv.conv.weight shape=[hidden,1,3], kernel=3, conv_L_cache=3 in config) -- a cheap, purely LOCAL token-mixing operator, structurally unrelated to Mamba/SSM (no state-space recurrence, no gating -- a plain small conv) and unrelated to attention (no QK similarity, no softmax).
architecture_TRIPLE_HYBRID.layer_type_sequence_note: roughly 1 full_attention per 4 layers, evenly spaced (verified: 10 attention layers across 40, matching every-4th position)

dense_vs_moe_split_CORRECTED.finding: the dense/MoE split is by ABSOLUTE POSITION (first 2 layers only), completely ORTHOGONAL to the conv/attention split -- both conv-type and full_attention-type layers carry MoE FFN everywhere except layers 0-1. This is architecturally distinct from every MoE specimen this session has touched (Qwen3-VL/O006, Qwen3-30B/O005, Kimi-VL/O003), none of which mix a THIRD structural axis (local conv) with the attention/MoE split.

moe_topology.note: expert_bias is a PER-LAYER F32 tensor (shape=[num_experts]) distinct from the gate weight -- a learned routing bias, not just the softmax/sigmoid gate itself; worth checking whether this changes routing-skew analysis methodology vs the gate-only routers examined for O003/O005/O006 this session.

architecture_TRIPLE_HYBRID.attention_detail: per-head Q/K RMSNorm (self_attn.q_layernorm/k_layernorm, shape=[head_dim]) inside each full_attention layer -- a stabilization detail not present in the transformer attention blocks touched elsewhere this session.

obvious_representation_opportunities: The dense-layer/MoE-layer split (by position, not by conv/attn type) means this session's new R-heterogeneous-organ-allocation-aggressive-only rule's origin condition ('kind==moe') needs refinement to apply cleanly here -- is the RIGHT unit of analysis 'MoE layers' (38/40) or 'the whole model' given 2 dense layers exist? A genuine transfer-rule precision question for a future pass, not resolved here.

conv layers are architecturally CHEAP (a single depthwise [hidden,1,3] kernel + 2 square projections) relative to attention layers (Q/K/V/O + per-head norms) -- Gravity pressure on the 30 conv layers vs 10 attention layers is a genuinely different allocation question than anything MoE-organ-focused examined this session.
failure_modes_not_yet_tested: No Doctor battery, no baseline TPS, no routing-skew measurement (would need a live trace, not config-derivable).
preliminary_disposition: RESEARCH SPECIMEN. Genuinely the most structurally complex specimen surveyed this session (3 combined axes: conv/attention/MoE). 9.76% active fraction is even sparser than O006's 11%. Worth a real Gravity pass once GPU time opens.

preliminary_star_resident_evaluation.resident_candidate: UNLIKELY BY SIZE: 44.4GiB stored footprint is large for a Resident role even with only 2.33B active/token (the FULL model must still be resident in memory for MoE routing to reach any expert) -- size argues against it despite the small active-compute figure.
preliminary_star_resident_evaluation.magnetar_candidate: PLAUSIBLE IF CAPABILITY HOLDS: architecturally sophisticated, worth a real battery.
preliminary_star_resident_evaluation.verdict: NO CLAIM BEYOND 'ARCHITECTURALLY THE RICHEST SPECIMEN SURVEYED' -- Odyssey I discovery only.
